meta.title: Health & Safety: looking after yourself, looking after each other

questions.prompt: How does the deck frame Health & Safety at college?
options: A list of rules to memorise
questions.explanation: The deck says it is 'a habit of mind — noticing'.

questions.prompt: Which of these 'switch noticing off'? Select all that apply.
options: Not wanting to make a fuss
questions.explanation: All four are listed as things that switch noticing off.

questions.prompt: What are good first points of contact if something isn't right? Select all that apply.
options: Post on the student Facebook group
Wait for the next staff meeting
questions.explanation: Tell your teacher — that's the first point of contact.

questions.prompt: Which PROUD value is this module grounded in?
questions.explanation: Show Respect is the PROUD anchor for Module C.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: lighting stands need sandbags on base legs when extended — this is ____ and BECTU industry standard.
questions.template: Lighting stands need sandbags on base legs when extended — this is ____ and BECTU industry standard.

questions.prompt: Which of these are common trip hazards in broadcast environments? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Trailing cables are the most common trip hazard in broadcast environments. Camera bags on the floor are also a hazard.

questions.prompt: Which of these are subject-specific safety rules in the deck? Select all that apply.
options: Closed-toe shoes in studios with lighting equipment
Wrist strap always on the camera; tripod head locked
Boom poles pass through doorways horizontally below head height
Coil and store cables immediately after use
questions.explanation: All four are subject-specific safety rules listed in the deck.

questions.prompt: How does the deck describe the act of reporting something that's not right?
options: It's not making a fuss — it's the system doing its job
It's something only staff should do
questions.explanation: Saying something is 'not making a fuss — not "telling on" anyone — just saying it, early.'
